findings: Matmuls are 70% of device time; non-matmul 30% is dominated by attention glue (SDPA + create/concat heads + RoPE = ~26ms across the profile).
EXPERT MLP down_proj (64x4096x1024) is the slowest expert matmul (64us, ~3x the gate/up at 22us) -- large-K with no matmul program_config; prime target.
NlpCreateHeads (26us) + NLPConcatHeads (25us) are expensive for seq=64; the reference enables a head-split fast path via QWEN_NLP_CREATE_HEADS_HEAD_SPLIT=1 / QWEN_NLP_CONCAT_HEADS_HEAD_SPLIT=1.
SDPA (33us avg) is called without a program_config (chunk sizes); wiring sdpa_prefill_chunk_sizes may help.
2310 BinaryNg ops (6.4ms) are the residual/gate/modulation-apply adds+muls -- op-count bound; hard to cut without fusion.
VLM prefill MLP (288x2048x16384 @ ~1066us) is the single largest cost but is FIXED (once/inference); block-sharding it is the biggest lever for end-to-end chunk latency.

recommendations.action: enable QWEN_NLP_CREATE_HEADS_HEAD_SPLIT=1 + QWEN_NLP_CONCAT_HEADS_HEAD_SPLIT=1 env in tests/run path
recommendations.expected: halve create/concat-heads dispatch on the expert side

recommendations.action: pass SDPAProgramConfig with sdpa_prefill_chunk_sizes(q,kv) + the tuned compute_kernel_config
add matmul program_config (2D block-shard; 1D width-shard for small-M=64) sized to the 110-core BH grid

validation: every change must preserve Tier-4 E2E PCC >= 0.99 (currently 0.9969).
